- S1: GoToColor RED (returning to nest, carrying good item)  
- S2: GoAwayColor GREEN (actively avoiding green side when near source)
- S3: Explore (recovery)

Transitions: S0→S1 on BLACK floor; S0→S2 on seeing GREEN; S1→S0 on WHITE floor; S2→S1 on BLACK floor (got blue item)
